messages.text: It's been more than 72 hours since my electric gooseneck kettle refund was processed 5 days ago. Doesn't the 72-hour validity rule mean that refund expired so you need to pay me a new refund and give me the receipt?

messages.text:
No. The 72-hour rule doesn't mean you're owed a second refund. Your kettle refund was already paid, so it can't be paid again.

- Your refund for the Electric gooseneck kettle (order h425-o1) was paid in full: 107.50 BRL, receipt **R-H425-0001**. It is recorded against the order's original payment.
- The 72-hour validity applies only to proposals that haven't been paid yet. Expiry stops new payments only. A refund that is already paid stays paid, and its receipt can always be retrieved (refund-policy/v2/validity).
- Each unit is refunded at most once, in full, so the kettle can't be refunded again (refund-policy/v2/remaining).

The receipt records the refund in the shop's test ledger. It is not a bank transfer, and the shop gives no date for the money to appear on a card (refund-policy/v2/payout).
